text: Normalize dot segments and compare complete path boundaries.

arguments.patch:
diff --git a/mini_data_utils/pathmatch.py b/mini_data_utils/pathmatch.py
--- a/mini_data_utils/pathmatch.py
+++ b/mini_data_utils/pathmatch.py
@@ -1,9 +1,13 @@
 """Path matching helpers with one audited boundary defect."""
 
+import posixpath
+
 
 def is_path_within(path: str, root: str) -> bool:
     """Return whether path is root itself or one of its descendants."""
 
-    normalized_path = path.replace("\\", "/").rstrip("/")
-    normalized_root = root.replace("\\", "/").rstrip("/")
-    return normalized_path.startswith(normalized_root)
+    normalized_path = posixpath.normpath(path.replace("\\", "/"))
+    normalized_root = posixpath.normpath(root.replace("\\", "/"))
+    return normalized_path == normalized_root or normalized_path.startswith(
+        f"{normalized_root}/"
+    )
